en.title: The EDGE Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland received high attention
en.summary: Since its publication, the Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland (REO) was downloaded over 1'800 times. It was highlighted in close to 40 articles, including the national ones: NZZ, Le Temps, as well as on TV in the SRF Eco Talk (14:48) and the RTS (04:21).
en.image_alt: The EDGE Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland received high attention
en.body:
Since its publication, the [Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland](https://archive-ouverte.unige.ch/unige:172640) (REO) was downloaded over 1'800 times. It was highlighted in close to 40 articles, including the national ones: [NZZ](https://revue-presse.unige.ch/files/articles/2024-04-08/430568645.pdf), [Le Temps](https://revue-presse.unige.ch/files/articles/2024-05-10/436602327.pdf), as well as on TV in the [SRF Eco Talk](https://www.srf.ch/play/tv/eco-talk/video/was-kostet-uns-das-stromgesetz?urn=urn:srf:video:8d859907-8bc8-4fa8-929d-2d507f897932) (14:48) and the [RTS](https://www.rts.ch/play/tv/19h30/video/la-confederation-ambitionne-de-disposer-dun-approvisionnement-en-electricite-entierement-renouvelable-dici-2035?urn=urn:rts:video:14636245) (04:21).

Reference: TRUTNEVYTE, Evelina et al. 2024. Doi: 10.13097/archive-ouverte/unige:172640.

Download the REO: https://archive-ouverte.unige.ch/unige:172640
